hits.title: The Trends of IT Convergence in Korea
hits.abstract: These days, the environment of IT development goes through converging with various industries and technologies. Also, it accelerates to pioneer new markets and develop new technologies. This trend becomes one of the most important factors to explore new national growth engines in Korea. Thus, this research examines current trends of IT convergence in Korea. The strategic characteristics of IT convergence in overseas are briefly explained for comparing purpose. The governmental strategies or efforts regarding the IT convergence have been surveyed. Some example convergences of LG, Samsung, and POSCO as major IT industries in Korea have been introduced. It also identifies several buzz concepts in this field. The study aims to provide an insight about the activities that are happening in the field of IT convergence in Korea. Finally, the findings through the research have been summarized.

hits.title: 국방IT융합 추진방법론 및 사례 연구
hits.abstract: Information technology convergence has been recognized one of the key drivers in the industry perspective. Korea government established IT convergence policy in 2008 and has been implementing it to the core industry such as automotive, shipbuilding and defense industries. This research analyzes various IT convergence issues based on an operation of defense IT convergence center, one of the industry IT convergence centers. Defense IT convergence issues are as follows : the methods for introducing rapid changing IT to military area, rapid deployment procedures of verified commercial technologies and products, regulations for using of domestic software promotion and so on. We define the concept of defense IT convergence and propose the framework and processes for applying IT to our defense sector as one of industries. Also, we establish various business models in the military perspective using defense IT convergence framework. In this paper, we focus the development of defense IT convergence through the alignment of national IT convergence policy and propose various business models established through operating a defense IT convergence center.

hits.abstract: Many scholars have addressed the technological convergence of small-medium sized firms in Korea and their impact on the economic growth of nation. Nevertheless, most studies have been investigated the relationship between entrepreneurship and venture creation, and a few studies have analyzed the innovation and technological convergence of SMEs. The purpose of this research is to gain industrial insight into the technological convergence and to suggest a dynamic growth policy for entrepreneurs of SMEs to improve their convergence performance based on IT and BT. Therefore, we intend to propose solutions to these key questions in convergence such as; what are the key patterns in the process of technological convergence of SMEs on IT and BT, and what kinds of strategy do their need? In order to answer these research questions, we adopt network analysis using patent citation information. Results of network analysis revealed that building ecosystem based on government and universities is one of the most important factors for the future growth of SMEs in Korea. Also, the fit between technological convergence direction of SMEs and division of convergence structure of government and universities will be positively associated with dynamic growth of SMEs in Korea. In conclusion, this research extends the current studies on important aspects of SMEs in the technological convergence process by proposing their growth in convergence process to a newly converging context, IT and BT, and shed light on the integrative perspectives of crucial roles of SMEs on innovation performance in the IT and BT technological convergence.

hits.abstract: Recently, The Bali Road Map was approved, as it demands that developing countries should also have the responsibility of greenhouse gas reduction from 2013. This suggests that the greenhouse gas and environment should be controlled across industry sectors. Accordingly, this study was conducted to identify the application and effects of the IT convergence technology to the smart farm and realize the low-carbon green industry in Korea. The smart farm technologies within and outside of Korea were comparatively analyzed for the low-carbon green industry policy. The study subjects were determined to propose the necessity of the study efficiently. First, the studies on the smart farm for low-carbon green industry policy were examined. Second, the suitable IT technology for the smart farm as well as the effect and the improvement plan of the IT technology-based smart farm system were examined. This study now aims to promote the low-carbon green industry policy and IT convergence technology and job creation. These will be achieved by providing the plan for linking the system simulator organization with the low-carbon green industry policy.

hits.title: Technological Convergence of IT and BT: Evidence from Patent Analysis
hits.abstract: In recent innovation trends, one notable feature is the merging and overlapping of technologies: in other words, technological convergence. A key technological convergence is the fusion of biotechnology (BT) and information technology (IT). Major IT advances have led to innovative devices that allow us to advance BT. However, the lack of data on IT-BT convergence is a major impediment: relatively little research has analyzed the inter-disciplinary relationship of different industries. We propose a systematic approach to analyzing the technological convergence of BT and IT. Patent analysis, including citation and co-classification analyses, was adopted as a main method to measure the convergence intensity and coverage, and two portfolio matrices were developed to manage the technological convergence. The contribution of this paper is that it provides practical evidences for IT-BT convergence, based on quantitative data and systematic processes. This has managerial implications for each sector of IT and BT.

hits.abstract: Recently, Korean software industry has enjoyed fast growth, thus phenomenon drew attention to the need for more precise and standardized cost estimation system for software development. However, many obstacles exist in achieving a more precise and universally applicable cost measurement. These obstacles include : (1) the intangible nature of intellectual efforts, (2) lack of cost standards, (3) lack of quantitative yardstick to determine the potential complication, (4) lack of both cost monitoring during development and coordinating between acquisition process and cost estimation. The purpose of this study is to facilitate software development cost estimation considering acquisition process that will meet korean user's needs, and to create better models that will be cost for software development particularly for Korean environment.

hits.title: IT/OT-Konvergenz: Status-Quo und Umsetzungsempfehlungen
hits.abstract:
Abstract

This study examines IT/OT Convergence in 31 predominantly large German companies. It presents an “IT/OT Governance Framework” as a specific model for successful convergence implementation. The analysis reveals a heterogeneous level of convergence maturity across the examined companies, the majority of which are at the beginning or in the implementation phase. Close cooperation between IT and OT is favored, but without IT completely taking over OT. An IT/OT tandem consisting of a CIO and a central OT responsible person is seen as the ideal way to take responsibility. Six specific recommendations were derived from the interviews and included in the IT/OT Governance Framework developed. These include ensuring top management support, using security as a driver, introducing a central OT responsible person, bringing IT and OT teams physically closer together, continuously demonstrating the added value of convergence, and taking a step-by-step approach to implementation.

hits.abstract: Competitiveness in the era of diversity, global environment, rapid change and customer satisfaction is very important not only for commercial business but also for the public service sector. This study will present the model, its adaptability and strategic methodology of Six Sigma application for the public service. Thus, This study explores to investigate whether Six Sigma implementation impacts the public service sector performances and then to find which Six Sigma techniques utilization impacts the public service sector performances in korea. It's time the substantial study on the introduction and implementation of the Six Sigma technology in the public service sector. In this study, we could find that organizational commitment improve after Six Sigma. Six Sigma essential factor have influence on organizational commitment a little. The purpose of this study is to research and analyze the influence of Six Sigma management in public service sector. The public service sector includes a wide range of organization such as local authorities responsible for education, social services and housing, the national health service, central government department like the treasury and ministry of defense, together with armed forces, and public cooperation such as post office and the K.T. Six Sigma Process is each stage to institutionalize through the standardization in order that it may be maintained and controlled by removing any defectives happened in the process and upgrading the level of sigma after the project being selected. They implemented Six sigma management from 1999. However they could not achieve full advantages of Six Sigma management because of short period of implementation time, but were able to achieve some performances in operational areas. 13 hypotheses is to be presented to show the structural relation of the Six Sigma management module for the public sector. This study covers the national public services and samples are from the Ministry of Information and Communication and KT (Korean Telecommunication). This study uses the covariance structure analysis to verify the relationship among the composing factors and the Lisrel package. After factor analysis, two multiple regressions were utilized to identify the critical Six Sigma techniques managerial factors for successful Six sigma implementation. Concerning critical success factors for Six Sigma implementation, Leadership is identified as critical success factors. Six Sigma organization culture is very important for successful Six Sigma project implementation. The result of this study shows that leadership, policy, information system is successful Six Sigma implementation. Of course, insider customer satisfaction is directly related with outsider satisfaction. As a result leadership based on customer oriented service, innovation in the management structure, communication and information system are the critical success factors for the Six Sigma implementation.

hits.title: Materials research activities in Korea
hits.abstract:
Abstract

Research and development on materials has emerged globally from the urgency for advanced materials to meet the challenges of the 21st century. Research activities have been continuously intensified in both academic and research institutes around the world and Korea has been no exception. MRS-Korea has been recently formed with the support of MRS-Japan and -USA. The global efforts in MR activities have been intensive, and paved the way for the MRS-international campaign. Current materials research in Korea encompasses mainly advanced materials (bulk, single crystals and thin film oxides, metals, and composites) as opposed to traditional materials (clay, metals, less refined materials). This article outlines the MR activities in Korea, for the benefit of MRS-international, and gives a brief history with emphasis on scientific programs. In the research community, the recent trend of MR activities has been moving towards cooperative research such as through industry-university, industry-institute, university-institute, and triads, industry-institute-university. Such types of activities are often referred to as consortium approaches, and are currently very popular throughout the world. Examples of such activities are given and the pros and cons of each system are discussed.

hits.title: An Analysis of Macro Aspects Caused by Protectionism in Korea
hits.abstract: Purpose - The global trend of protectionism has expanded since the onset of US President Donald Trump's administration in 2017. This global phenomenon has led to a significant reduction in world trade volume and a negative impact on economic development in some countries where the external sector accounts for a large proportion of GDP. Although Korea is a country vulnerable to this deteriorating trade environment, few studies have examined the relationship between protectionism and its business cycles based on Korean data. Thus, this paper investigates the impact of protectionism on Korea's business cycle. Design/methodology - To identify future implications, we conduct a structural vector autoregression (VAR) analysis using monthly Korean data from 1994 to 2015. Macroeconomic variables in the model include the industrial production index, inflation rates, exports (or net exports), interest rates, and exchange rates. For the identification of the shock reflecting the expansion of protectionism, we use an antidumping investigation (ADI) data. Since ADIs are followed generally by the imposition of antidumping tariffs, they have no contemporaneous impact on tariffs and are also contemporaneously exogenous to other endogenous variables in the VAR model. We examine two kinds of ADI shocks i) shocks on Korean exports imposed by Korea's trading partners (ADI-imposed shocks) and ii) shocks on imports imposed by the Korean government (ADI-imposing shocks). Findings - We find that Korea's exports decline sharply due to ADI-imposed shocks; the lowest point at the third month after the initial shock; and do not recover until 24 months later. Simultaneously, the inflation rate decreases. Therefore, the ADI-imposed shock can be regarded as a negative shock on the demand curve where both production and price decrease. In contrast, the ADI-imposing shock generates a different response. The net exports decline, but the inflation rate increases. These can be seen as standard responses with respect to the negative shock on the supply curve. Originality/value - We shed light on the relationship between protectionism and Korea's economic fluctuations, which is rarely addressed in previous studies. We also consider the effects of both protective policy measures on imports to Korea imposed by the Korean government and on policy measures imposed by Korea's trading partner countries on its exports.

hits.title: Development of a National Research Data Platform for Sharing and Utilizing Research Data
hits.abstract: Research data means data used or created in the course of research or experiments. Research data is very important for validationof research conducted and for use in future research and projects. Recently, convergence research between various fields andinternational cooperation has been continuously done due to the explosive increase of research data and the increase in thecomplexity of science and technology. Developed countries are actively promoting open science policies that share researchresults and processes to create new knowledge and values through convergence research. Communities to promote the sharingand utilization of research data such as RDA (Research Data Alliance) and COAR (Confederation of Open Access Repositories)are active, and various platforms for managing and sharing research data are being developed and used. OpenAIRE (Open AccessInfrastructure for Research In Europe), a research data platform in Europe, ARDC (Australian Research Data Commons) in Australia,and IRDB (Institutional Repositories DataBase) in Japan provide research data or research data related services. Korea has beenestablishing and implementing a research data sharing and utilization strategy to promote the sharing and utilization of researchdata at the national level, led by the central government. Based on this strategy, KISTI has been building a Korean research dataplatform (DataON) since 2018, and has been providing research data sharing and utilization services to users since January 2020.This paper reviews the characteristics of DataON and how it is used for research by showing its applications.

hits.abstract: This study was a qualitative case study which describes and analyzes a specific case of how to select and cultivate core specialists connected with corporation’s core competence. This study evaluated such processes within a specific Korean traditional food and beverage manufacturing company with applied SDT(Strategic Development of Talent) process. The data was mainly collected throughout participative observations and interviews with four human resource development staffs.This study found that, in order to cultivate core specialist, an organization needs to select core jobs and core specialists connected with a corporation’s core competency, to set up the number of target people, to implement cultivating programs through work experience and planned career development plan, to propose a clear vision, and to continuously improve the program by evaluating it. hits.abstract: The purpose of this study is to identify the problems of environmental impact assessment(EIA) and to suggest new EIA technology. The problems of EIA in Korea can be summarized as follows. First, the EIA does not reflect the impact of policy, plan and program on environment. Second, the project EIA does not consider the cumulative impacts such as additive impacts, synergistic impacts, threshold/saturation impacts, induced and indirect impacts, time-crowded impacts, and space-crowded impacts. Third, the EIA techniques in Korea are not standardized. Finally, the present EIA suggests only alternatives to reduce adverse impacts. To solve above-mentioned problems, the development of new EIA technology is essential. First, the new EIA technology should be developed toward pollution prevention technology and comprehensive and integrated environmental management technology. Second, new fields of EIA for pollution prevention contain strategic environmental assessment, cumulative impacts assessment, socio-economic impact assessment, cyber EIA and EIA technology necessary after the reunification of Korean Peninsula. Third, EIA technology for integrated environmental management contains the development of integated environment assessment system and the development of packaged EIA technology. The EIA technology for integrated environmental assessment system contains (1) development of integrated impact assessment technology combining air/water quality model, GIS and remote sensing, (2) integrated impact assessment of EIA, traffic impact assessment, population impact assessment and disaster impact assessment. (3) development of integrated technology combining risk assessment and EIA (4) development of integrated technology of life cycle assessment and EIA, (5) development of integrated technology of spatial planning and EIA, (6) EIA technology for biodiversity towards sustainable development, (7) mathematical model and GIS based location decision techniques, and (8) environmental monitoring and audit. Furthermore, there are some fields which need packaged EIA technology. In case of dam development, urban or industrial complex development, tourist development, landfill or combustion facilities construction, electric power plant development, development of port, road/rail/air port, is necessary the standardized and packaged EIA technology which considers the common characteristics of the same kind of development project.

The target data set included heterogenous contents such as blogs, news, and academic materials that were accumulated between May 1, 2018 and April 30, 2020 in Naver and Daum sites. hits.abstract: Over the past decade, defense intelligence organizations have evolved rapidly to perform new missions. They have developed new capabilities and adapted their business processes, especially in support of joint and complex military operations. But in the coming decade, their greatest challenge will be to develop new capabilities to manage and exploit big data. We use the term big data to mean the exponentially increasing amount of digital information being created by new information technologies—such as mobile Internet, cloud storage, social networking, and the “Internet of things”—and the advanced analytics used to process that data. Big data yields not simply a quantitative increase in information, but a qualitative change in how we create new knowledge and understand the world. These data-related information technologies have already begun to revolutionize commerce and science, transforming the economy and acting as enablers for other game-changing technology trends. In defense intelligence communities, some of these technologies have been adopted for tasks, including technical collection and operational intelligence fusion—but big data의 impact on all-source intelligence analysis has scarcely been examined.&#xD; Defense Big Data Maturity Models(DBDMM) are the artefacts used to measure defense big data maturity. These models help organizations to create structure around their big data capabilities and to identify where to start. They provide tools that assist organizations to define goals around their big data program and to communicate their big data vision to the entire organization. DBDMMs also provide a methodology to measure and monitor the state of a defense big data capability, the effort required to complete their current stage or phase of maturity and to progress to the next stage. Additionally, DBDMMs measure and manage the speed of both the progress and adoption of big data programs in the organization.&#xD; &#xD; The goals of DBDMMs are:&#xD; 1) To provide a capability assessment tool that generates specific focus on big data in key defense areas&#xD; 2) To help guide development milestones&#xD; 3) To avoid pitfalls in establishing and building big data capabilities&#xD; &#xD; Six assessment areas of DBDMMs refer to ① big data policy, ② big data organization, ③ big data use and process, ④ big data technology, ⑤ big data security, and ⑥ big data people. And the subcomponents include alignment, architecture, data, data governance, delivery, development, measurement, program governance, scope, skills, statistical modelling, technology, value and visualization etc.&#xD; &#xD; The five stages of maturity of the proposed model are proposed as follows: &#xD; 1) Awareness - the starting stage for use of a new or undocumented repeating process. The awarenes stage as a pre–big data environment. During this stage the organization has a low awareness of big data or its value; There is little to no executive support for the effort and only some people in the organization are interested in potential value of big data; The Organization understand the benefits of analytics and may have a data warehouse. An organization의 governance strategy is typically more IT-centric rather than being integrative business-and-IT centric.&#xD; 2) Start-up - the process is at least big data sufficiently. During the pre-adoption stage: The organization start to investigate big data analytics.&#xD; 3) Investment - the financing is defined/confirmed as a standard business process&#xD; 4) Strategic utilization - the process is quantitatively managed in accordance with defense metric view point.&#xD; 5) Optimization - process management includes deliberate process optimization/improvement.&#xD; &#xD; The study helps defense related organizations in Korea determine 1) where it currently lands on the big data maturity spectrum, and 2) take steps to get to the next level.빅데이터 시대를 맞이하여 국방부문에서도 앞 다투어 빅데이터 정책 및 사업을 추진하고 있다. 그러나 내부를 파악해보면 데이터 수집과 분석 능력을 보유한 일부 IT기업이나 금융회사 등 대기업 중심으로 추진되고 있고 국방 분야의 경우에는 단발성 프로젝트 위주로 빅데이터 사업을 제한적으로 시행하거나 기존에 수행해오던 정보화 관련 사업을 빅데이터 사업으로 사업 명칭만 바꾼 사례도 있다. &#xD; 국방 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 국방과 연관된 분야에서 빅데이터 정책을 계획수립 또는 수립하고 있거나 현재 도입중인 군관련 기관 및 방산업체들이 이러한 문제에 직면하게 되었을 때 필요한 일종의 지침을 제공하기 위한 목적으로 개발하였다. 즉, 국방 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 국방 빅데이터 정책 전반에 대한 이해를 제고하고, 조직구성원들과 협력 및 의사소통을 구할 수 있으며, 빅데이터와 관련하여 무엇을 어디에서부터 개시해야 하는지에 대한 확실한 가이드라인을 제공한다. 그리고 지금 무엇을 하고 있으며 어떤 것을 못하고 있는지, 빅데이터 수준이 어디까지 와있고 어느 정도의 수준에까지 도달했는지 기준을 제공한다. 또한 향후 빅데이터 정책이나 추진의 방향성이 어떠한지도 제시해 주며, 또한 국방 분야의 빅데이터 수준을 진단하거나 상호 비교 및 평가하여 국방 분야 빅데이터 정책 수립에 활용될 수 있을 것이다. &#xD; 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 평가영역과 발전단계의 수로 구성된다. 본 논문에서는 평가영역을 설정하기 위하여 전문가를 대상으로 한 합의 델파이 방법(Consensus Delphi method)을 적용하여 ① 빅데이터 정책, ② 빅데이터 조직, ③ 빅데이터 활용 및 프로세스, ④ 빅데이터 기술, ⑤ 빅데이터 보안, ⑥ 빅데이터 인력의 6개 영역을 선정하였다. 빅데이터 정책에는 빅데이터 계획과 빅데이터 전략, 빅데이터 정책 결정 등을 포함하고 있으며, 빅데이터 조직에는 빅데이터 전담조직 및 추진 체계, 빅데이터 거버넌스 구축 및 빅데이터 표준화와 품질관리 조직 등을 평가 대상으로 하고 있으며, 빅데이터 활용 및 프로세스에는 데이터의 출처 및 용도, 빅데이터 생성과정, 빅데이터 구조를 포함하고 있으며, 빅데이터 기술에는 빅데이터의 수집, 저장 및 분석 역량과 최적화 기술역량을 등을 평가 한다. 빅데이터 보안에는 보안 등급 및 관련 규정 및 공공데이터의 성격을 가지는 경우 개방성에 대한 판단도 주요한 평가 대상으로 포함하고 있으며, 마지막으로 빅데이터 인력에서는 IT전문가 집단의 역량, 데이터 과학자의 역량 및 리더십과 운영인력 등을 평가할 수 있을 것이다. &#xD; 6개의 평가영역과 더불어 성숙도 단계를 인지단계, 착수단계, 예산투입단계, 활용단계, 최적화 단계의 다섯 단계로 구성하였다. 인지단계는 전체적으로 빅데이터에 대한 인식 정도가 낮고 사용 가능한 수준의 빅데이터가 거의 없고 제한된 영역 내에서만 빅데이터 분석이 적용되는 단계를 의미한다. 착수단계는 국방 빅데이터에 대한 종사자의 인식 변화가 태동하며 국방 빅데이터 기술 및 지식을 습득하고 군 고유의 데이터 플랫폼과 인프라 스트럭처를 구성하지만, 도구(tool)과 기술이 제한적인 수준임을 의미한다. 예산투입 단계는 국방 빅데이터 분석 활동의 시작을 의미하는데, 효율적인 빅데이터 사용이 가능하고, 여러 가지 종류의 국방 빅데이터 기술과 빅데이터 조직과 거버넌스 체계가 존재하며 외부 사용자나 방산업체 등에서 생성된 데이터에 대한 이해도가 높은 수준을 의미한다. 활용단계는 빅데이터 분석 기술이 중요해지며 분석 및 해석이 중요해지는 단계로 예측과 시각화 응용 프로그램의 사용이 가능하며 IT 시스템 아키텍처가 군 내부자원의 보안을 보장하는 단계이다. 끝으로 최적화 단계는 국방 빅데이터 분석이 경제적 부가 가치를 창출하는 단계와 연관되며, 군 빅데이터가 강력한 빅데이터 거버넌스 하에 국방 관련 조직 전체로 공유되는 단계이며, 이 단계는 데이터 아트(art) 수준의 작업이 수행되는 단계를 말한다. &#xD; 본 연구에서 개발한 국방 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 시범 모형의 일종으로서 앞으로 국방 분야의 다양한 과업에서 실질적인 적용을 통하여 수정되고 보완되어 지속적으로 발전되어야 할 것이다.

국방 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 국방과 연관된 분야에서 빅데이터 정책을 계획수립 또는 수립하고 있거나 현재 도입중인 군관련 기관 및 방산업체들이 이러한 문제에 직면하게 되었을 때 필요한 일종의 지침을 제공하기 위한 목적으로 개발하였다. 즉, 국방 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 국방 빅데이터 정책 전반에 대한 이해를 제고하고, 조직구성원들과 협력 및 의사소통을 구할 수 있으며, 빅데이터와 관련하여 무엇을 어디에서부터 개시해야 하는지에 대한 확실한 가이드라인을 제공한다. 그리고 지금 무엇을 하고 있으며 어떤 것을 못하고 있는지, 빅데이터 수준이 어디까지 와있고 어느 정도의 수준에까지 도달했는지 기준을 제공한다. 또한 향후 빅데이터 정책이나 추진의 방향성이 어떠한지도 제시해 주며, 또한 국방 분야의 빅데이터 수준을 진단하거나 상호 비교 및 평가하여 국방 분야 빅데이터 정책 수립에 활용될 수 있을 것이다. &#xD; 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 평가영역과 발전단계의 수로 구성된다. 본 논문에서는 평가영역을 설정하기 위하여 전문가를 대상으로 한 합의 델파이 방법(Consensus Delphi method)을 적용하여 ① 빅데이터 정책, ② 빅데이터 조직, ③ 빅데이터 활용 및 프로세스, ④ 빅데이터 기술, ⑤ 빅데이터 보안, ⑥ 빅데이터 인력의 6개 영역을 선정하였다. 빅데이터 정책에는 빅데이터 계획과 빅데이터 전략, 빅데이터 정책 결정 등을 포함하고 있으며, 빅데이터 조직에는 빅데이터 전담조직 및 추진 체계, 빅데이터 거버넌스 구축 및 빅데이터 표준화와 품질관리 조직 등을 평가 대상으로 하고 있으며, 빅데이터 활용 및 프로세스에는 데이터의 출처 및 용도, 빅데이터 생성과정, 빅데이터 구조를 포함하고 있으며, 빅데이터 기술에는 빅데이터의 수집, 저장 및 분석 역량과 최적화 기술역량을 등을 평가 한다. 빅데이터 보안에는 보안 등급 및 관련 규정 및 공공데이터의 성격을 가지는 경우 개방성에 대한 판단도 주요한 평가 대상으로 포함하고 있으며, 마지막으로 빅데이터 인력에서는 IT전문가 집단의 역량, 데이터 과학자의 역량 및 리더십과 운영인력 등을 평가할 수 있을 것이다. &#xD; 6개의 평가영역과 더불어 성숙도 단계를 인지단계, 착수단계, 예산투입단계, 활용단계, 최적화 단계의 다섯 단계로 구성하였다. 인지단계는 전체적으로 빅데이터에 대한 인식 정도가 낮고 사용 가능한 수준의 빅데이터가 거의 없고 제한된 영역 내에서만 빅데이터 분석이 적용되는 단계를 의미한다. 착수단계는 국방 빅데이터에 대한 종사자의 인식 변화가 태동하며 국방 빅데이터 기술 및 지식을 습득하고 군 고유의 데이터 플랫폼과 인프라 스트럭처를 구성하지만, 도구(tool)과 기술이 제한적인 수준임을 의미한다. 예산투입 단계는 국방 빅데이터 분석 활동의 시작을 의미하는데, 효율적인 빅데이터 사용이 가능하고, 여러 가지 종류의 국방 빅데이터 기술과 빅데이터 조직과 거버넌스 체계가 존재하며 외부 사용자나 방산업체 등에서 생성된 데이터에 대한 이해도가 높은 수준을 의미한다. 활용단계는 빅데이터 분석 기술이 중요해지며 분석 및 해석이 중요해지는 단계로 예측과 시각화 응용 프로그램의 사용이 가능하며 IT 시스템 아키텍처가 군 내부자원의 보안을 보장하는 단계이다. 끝으로 최적화 단계는 국방 빅데이터 분석이 경제적 부가 가치를 창출하는 단계와 연관되며, 군 빅데이터가 강력한 빅데이터 거버넌스 하에 국방 관련 조직 전체로 공유되는 단계이며, 이 단계는 데이터 아트(art) 수준의 작업이 수행되는 단계를 말한다. &#xD; 본 연구에서 개발한 국방 빅데이터 성숙도 모형은 시범 모형의 일종으로서 앞으로 국방 분야의 다양한 과업에서 실질적인 적용을 통하여 수정되고 보완되어 지속적으로 발전되어야 할 것이다.

hits.abstract: In 2015, Ministry of Health and Welfare of Korea announced a research and development plan of using Korean healthcare data to support decision making, reduce cost and enhance a better treatment. This project relies on the adoption of BigData technology such as Apache Hadoop, Apache Spark to store and process HealthCare Data from various institution. Here we present an approach a design and implementation of OLAP server in Korean HealthCare BigData platform. This approach is used to establish a basis for promoting personalized healthcare research for decision making, forecasting disease and developing customized diagnosis and treatment.

hits.title: Future Public Conflicts That Aging Will Bring in Korea: A Comparative Analysis of Korea and Japan
hits.abstract: The purpose of this study is to analyze Korea’s aging society in terms of public conflict, to analyze the conflict issues that aging will bring, and to present a pre-emptive response. Methods adopted to this end include a literature review and comparative case analyses involving Korea and Japan. Three issues of public conflict were selected in the literature review: (1) increased demand for cremation facilities, (2) expansion of elderly care and dementia facilities, and (3) job competition between the young and elderly due to the extended legal retirement age. Then, by applying the conflict process frame of Ralf Dahrendorf and Lewis Coser, the two countries were analyzed in terms of structural situations, deepening awareness of these situations, and mobilization of organizational-political power. The study thereby deduced implications regarding the differences between the two countries. Korea and Japan are experiencing similar social phenomena or problems due to aging. However, there are some differences between the countries in how these phenomena are perceived and how the problems are solved. The background of these differences can be summarized as (1) long-standing ideological confrontation in Korea, (2) differences between Japan and Korea in the cultural perception of conflict, and (3) differences in governance in terms of social consensus and institutional acceptance.

hits.abstract: 최근 IT, BT, NT 기술간 융합이 가속화되면서 새로운 형태의 기술과 서비스가 등장하고 있다. 미국, 일본, 유럽 등 선진국은 정부와 기업이 연대하여 기술간 융합을 고부가가치 창출에 필요한 첨단기술로 인식하고 융합기술 개발을 적극적으로 추진하고 있고, 우리 정부도 과학기술부, 산업자원부, 정보통신부를 중심으로 융합기술 발전계획을 수립하고 있다. 융합기술 개발을 통해 미래의 핵심기술을 확보하고, 컨버전스 시대의 조류에 대응하며, 새로운 성장동력을 창출하고, 건강하고 안전한 삶을 실현할 수 있다. 본고에서는 먼저 IT-BT-NT 융합기술의 분류, 특징 및 기대효과를 살펴보고, 산업육성전략 방안을 제시하고자 한다.

hits.abstract: 조선 후기의 대표적인 계획 도시인 수원 화성은 정조의 정치적 이상이 집약된 공간으로, 단지 물리적 조영을 넘어 정치·사상·문화 전반을 아우르는 의도적 기획이었다. 정조는 효를 근간으로 한 유교 정치 이념과 왕도정치 실현을 위한 이상국가 공간화를 목표로 화성을 조영했으며, 이는 천인합일, 백성과의 인화, 그리고 왕권의 정당성을 하늘의 뜻에 부합시키려는 시도였다. 이러한 이상을 실현하기 위한 실천적 장치로서 정조는 화성 영건의 전 과정에 걸쳐 택일(擇日)을 적용했다. 이는 유교 국가의 위계와 질서를 건축물에 구현하고, 자연의 불변하는 질서속에 인간 사회의 안정과 지속 가능성을 추구하려 했던 정조 정치철학의 구체적 발현으로 건축을 천도와 감응하는 의례적 활동으로 구상하였다. 궁극적으로 택일은 개인의 안위와 건축 성공을 넘어, 인간과 자연, 사회 전체의 조화를 통한 대동(大同) 세계 실현이라는 유교적 이상국가 건설의 실천적 방법론으로 기능하였다.&#xD; 본 연구는 화성 축성 과정에 나타난 택일 문화를 중심으로, 건축 조영이 정조 정치철학의 실천 수단이자 감응적 세계관의 구체적 실현 방식이었음을 밝히고자 하였다. 이를 위해 문헌 분석과 실제 화성 건축의 택일 사례 비교, 상량문 해석을 병행하여 택일이 시간 선택을 넘어 정치적 상징화, 윤리적 정당화, 사상적 구현이라는 복합적 의미 속에서 작동했음을 실증적으로 고찰하였다. 연구 결과, 첫째, 화성 축성은 정조의 천인합일 사상이 건축과 의례를 통해 실현된 택일의 사유적 의미와 실천적 적용이 집약된 국가적 사업의 사례였다. 축성 과정에서 터 닦기, 정초, 입주, 상량 등 각 공정의 택일은 음양오행, 천문 등에 근거한 길일로 정밀하게 구성, 시행되었으며, 특히 상량은 공사의 완결성과 국가적 의례의 성격을 동시에 띤 의식으로서, 이에 상응하는 상길(上吉)로 분류되는 길일이 선택되었다는 점에서 정조의 정치이념이 시간과 공간 속에 제도화된 실천임을 드러낸다. 둘째,『천기대요』와 『협길통의』의 비교를 통해 택일서의 구조와 내용이 시대적 요구에 따라 어떻게 변화·정비되었는지를 확인할 수 있었다. 『천기대요』는 길흉 판단의 총론적 성격이 강한 반면, 『협길통의』는 시헌력 도입 이후의 정밀한 천문 계산을 바탕으로 조선의 행정 실무와 제도에 맞게 실용적이고 항목 중심으로 재구성되었다. 이는 택일 이론이 조선 후기의 행정 실무와 제도 운영에 적합하도록 간결화되고 실용적으로 재구성되었음을 보여준다. 셋째, 택일서는 택일의 이론적 정당화와 제도화를 가능하게 하는 지식 체계로 기능하였다. 택일서 등은 여러 이론들을 기준으로 길흉 판단의 근거를 제시하며, 관상감과 관료, 민간까지 아우르는 실천 지침서로 활용되었다. 특히, 국가 중심으로 택일서를 재정비하고 편찬하여, 이를 화성 축성의 택일 기준으로 활용함으로써 전통적 시간 인식 체계를 정치적 실천의 도구로 전환시켰다. 화성 축성에서 택일은 미신적 시간 선택이 아니라 정치 권위의 정당화, 국가 질서의 구현, 의례적 정당성 확보를 위한 문화적 장치로 기능하였다. 넷째, 공정별 택일은 각 단계의 기능과 상징성을 반영하여 정밀하게 적용되었으며, 이는 건축에서 기능성과 상징성을 동시에 구현하고자 했던 정조의 건축 철학이 시간 의식 안에서 구현되었음을 시사한다. 다섯째, 건축물 유형별 택일은 건물의 상징성과 기능에 따라 차등 적용되었다. 성문은 성곽의 출입구로서 이에 따른 길일 중심으로 정제되었다. 주요 성곽은 군령과 감시의 상징 공간으로서, 강력한 길일 요소가 적용되었고, 부속 성곽은 기능적 제약과 일정상 현실적 요인에 따라 길흉이 병존하는 양상을 보였다. 전각 및 제례 공간에서는 정치적·의례적 위상을 반영한 정교한 택일이 이루어졌는데 유교적 덕성과 조화를 상징하는 길일이 반복적으로 적용되었다. 이는 건축을 통한 정치적 메시지의 표출이 택일을 통해 제의적으로 실현된 사례로 해석된다. 여섯째, 상량문은 단순한 공사 기록이 아닌, 건축 공간의 상징성과 정치 이념을 반영하는 의례적‧사상적 구조물로서 건축과 택일, 정치철학과 시간 선택이 결합되어 화성 축성의 정신을 함축적으로 전달하고 있다. 현륭원과의 상징적 연계를 통해 화성 전체가 정조의 효치 사상과 왕권 정당성, 유교 정치 실현 공간임을 강조하며 조선 후기 국가 건축의 사상적 기반과 제도적 정합성을 입증하는 핵심 자료임이 확인되었다.&#xD; 결론적으로 화성 축성은 조선 후기 정조의 정치적 이상, 유교적 이념, 실학적 지식, 제도적 실행력이 통합된 대표적인 국가 주도 건축 사례로서, 축성 과정 전반에 걸쳐 관상감 등 전문기구를 통해 의도적이고 철저한 택일 절차를 적용함으로써, 건축이라는 실천 행위 속에 천인합일(天人合一), 음양오행, 인화(人和)의 사상적 요소를 유기적으로 통합하고자 하였다. 택일은 자연현상의 시간적 조응을 넘어 인간의 모든 행위에 질서와 당위성을 부여하는 기호 체계이자 상징 질서로서의 의미를 내포하며, 단순한 시간 배정 도구가 아닌 사상과 질서, 통치의 정당성을 실현하는 매개 장치로 기능하였다.  Hwaseong Fortress in Suwon which was a representative planned city of the late Joseon dynasty was a concentrated space of political ideals of Kong Jeongjo. It was an intentionally integrated project embracing not only physical construction but also political, ideological, and cultural dimensions. King Jeongjo constructed Hwaseong with the purpose of realizing a model nation based on filial duty-centered Confucian political ideology and royal governance. It was an attempt to align harmony between Heaven and humans, unity with the people, and legitimacy of sovereign power with the will of Heaven. As a practical device to realize such ideals, King Jeongjo applied Taekgil(擇日), throughout the entire process of constructing Hwaseong Fortress. It planned to manifest Hwaseong Fortress construction as ceremonial activities, presenting specific political philosophy of King Jeongjo, which realizes hierarchical ranking and order of a Confucian state into the structure, and pursues stability and sustainability of human society in the preserved order of nature. Ultimately, going beyond personal well-being and architectural success, Taekgil functioned as a practical methodology for constructing an ideal Confucian state called Daedong (大同) through the harmony of humanity, nature, and society.&#xD;  Focusing on Taekgil culture revealed for the construction of Hwaseong, this study has a purpose to present the architectural construction as a practical tool for political philosophy of Kong Jeongjo, and a specific method for realizing a sensitizing worldview. In order to achieve the purpose, this study simultaneously conducted literature analysis, comparative review of Taekgil cases in actual constructions, and interpretation of Sangnyangmun, so that it empirically researched that Taekgil functioned within a multiple meaning such as political symbolism, ethical justification, and ideological embodiment, beyond just selecting times.  As a result of research, first, the construction of Hwaseong was a national project that had a concentrated-philosophical significance and practical application of Taekgil, which had been conducted through architectural construction and ceremony, realizing ideological harmony between Heaven and humans from King Jeongjo. During the construction processes, every Tagil of each construction phase, such as site preparation, foundation laying, moving in, and roof-raising called Sangnyang, was precisely composed and implemented at auspicious days based on Yin-Yang and Five Elements and astronomical principles. In particular, as the Sangnyang (roof-raising) was a significant event, which includes meaningful symbols of construction completion and national ritual ceremony, the most auspicious day called Sanggil (上吉) was selected, in which political ideology of King Jeongjo was institutionalized and ritualized in time and space. Second, by comparing 『Cheongidaeyo』와 『Hyeopgil Tongui』, this study could find how the structure and content of Taigilseo had been revised to meet the demands of era. While 『Cheongidaeyo』 emphasized general principles for judging fortune and misfortune, 『Hyeopgil Tongui』 was reconstructed in a practical and item-centered content, which is suitable for the administrative practices and institutional systems of the Joseon Dynasty, based on precise astronomical calculation after adopting Shiheonryeok. This shows that Taekgil theory was simplified and reorganized more practically in order to suit the administrative operations of late Joseon. Third, Taekgilseo functioned as a knowledge system enabling theoretical justification and institutionalization of Taekgil. The Tegilseo and the other manuals offered grounds for determining fortune or misfortune based on various theories, and they were utilized as practical guidelines that Gwansanggam, officials, and even the general public used. Particularly, Taekgilseo was revised and published by the governments.  As it was utilized for criteria to select Taekgil for the construction of Hwaseong, traditional time-recognition systems were transformed into tools for political implements. In the construction of Hwaseong, Taekgil functioned not as a superstition to select time but as a cultural mechanism for legitimizing political authority, realizing national order, and securing ritual validity. Fourth, Taekgil of each construction phase was precisely applied by reflecting function and symbolism of them, and it implies that the architectural philosophy of King Jeongjo, which pursued simultaneously realizing functionality and symbolism, was embodied in the time consciousness. Fifth, the application of Taekgil varied depending on the type and symbolism of the buildings. In the case of gates, as they were entrances to the fortress, they were refined based on the related auspicious day. The main fortifications, as symbolic spaces of military command and surveillance, were adopted with strong elements for an auspicious day. Auxiliary fortifications showed a mix of auspicious and inauspicious elements because of functional limitations and realistic scheduling affairs. In the case of pavilions and ritual spaces, sophisticated Taekgil was applied to reflect political and ritual status. Auspicious days symbolizing Confucian virtues and harmony were repeatedly used. These are interpreted as a case that political messages through constructions were ritually conducted through Taekgil. Sixth, Sangnyangmun was not only construction records, but also ritual and ideological structures, reflecting the symbolism of architectural space and political ideology. It implicitly presented the spirit of Hwaseong construction by combining construction, Taekgil, political philosophy, and time selection. Through symbolic linkage with Hyeonnyungwon, this study emphasized that the entire Hwaseong is an implemented space of filial duty-centered Confucian political ideology, royal legitimacy, and Confucian political values of King Jeongjo, and this study verified that the construction is significant data to serve as critical materials, which prove ideological foundation and institutional coherence of national architecture in late Joseon Dynasty. &#xD;  In conclusion, the construction of Hwaseong was an integrated representative case of nation-led architecture in late Joseon Dynasty, including political ideology, Confucian principles, practical knowledge, and institutional execution ability. Across the construction process, by applying deliberate and thorough Taekgil process through specialized agencies such as Gwansanggam, philosophical elements of Harmony between Heaven and Humans, it was tried to incorporate organically Yin-Yang and the Five Elements, and Human Harmony. Not only did the Taekgil respond to natural temporal phenomena but also it involved the meaning of symbol system and semiotic order that granted human activity with order and legitimacy. Taekgil served not only as a tool for time allocation but also as a medium mechanism for realizing ideology, order, and political legitimacy.

결론적으로 화성 축성은 조선 후기 정조의 정치적 이상, 유교적 이념, 실학적 지식, 제도적 실행력이 통합된 대표적인 국가 주도 건축 사례로서, 축성 과정 전반에 걸쳐 관상감 등 전문기구를 통해 의도적이고 철저한 택일 절차를 적용함으로써, 건축이라는 실천 행위 속에 천인합일(天人合一), 음양오행, 인화(人和)의 사상적 요소를 유기적으로 통합하고자 하였다. 택일은 자연현상의 시간적 조응을 넘어 인간의 모든 행위에 질서와 당위성을 부여하는 기호 체계이자 상징 질서로서의 의미를 내포하며, 단순한 시간 배정 도구가 아닌 사상과 질서, 통치의 정당성을 실현하는 매개 장치로 기능하였다.  Hwaseong Fortress in Suwon which was a representative planned city of the late Joseon dynasty was a concentrated space of political ideals of Kong Jeongjo. It was an intentionally integrated project embracing not only physical construction but also political, ideological, and cultural dimensions. King Jeongjo constructed Hwaseong with the purpose of realizing a model nation based on filial duty-centered Confucian political ideology and royal governance. It was an attempt to align harmony between Heaven and humans, unity with the people, and legitimacy of sovereign power with the will of Heaven. As a practical device to realize such ideals, King Jeongjo applied Taekgil(擇日), throughout the entire process of constructing Hwaseong Fortress. It planned to manifest Hwaseong Fortress construction as ceremonial activities, presenting specific political philosophy of King Jeongjo, which realizes hierarchical ranking and order of a Confucian state into the structure, and pursues stability and sustainability of human society in the preserved order of nature. Ultimately, going beyond personal well-being and architectural success, Taekgil functioned as a practical methodology for constructing an ideal Confucian state called Daedong (大同) through the harmony of humanity, nature, and society.&#xD;  Focusing on Taekgil culture revealed for the construction of Hwaseong, this study has a purpose to present the architectural construction as a practical tool for political philosophy of Kong Jeongjo, and a specific method for realizing a sensitizing worldview. In order to achieve the purpose, this study simultaneously conducted literature analysis, comparative review of Taekgil cases in actual constructions, and interpretation of Sangnyangmun, so that it empirically researched that Taekgil functioned within a multiple meaning such as political symbolism, ethical justification, and ideological embodiment, beyond just selecting times.  As a result of research, first, the construction of Hwaseong was a national project that had a concentrated-philosophical significance and practical application of Taekgil, which had been conducted through architectural construction and ceremony, realizing ideological harmony between Heaven and humans from King Jeongjo. During the construction processes, every Tagil of each construction phase, such as site preparation, foundation laying, moving in, and roof-raising called Sangnyang, was precisely composed and implemented at auspicious days based on Yin-Yang and Five Elements and astronomical principles. In particular, as the Sangnyang (roof-raising) was a significant event, which includes meaningful symbols of construction completion and national ritual ceremony, the most auspicious day called Sanggil (上吉) was selected, in which political ideology of King Jeongjo was institutionalized and ritualized in time and space. Second, by comparing 『Cheongidaeyo』와 『Hyeopgil Tongui』, this study could find how the structure and content of Taigilseo had been revised to meet the demands of era. While 『Cheongidaeyo』 emphasized general principles for judging fortune and misfortune, 『Hyeopgil Tongui』 was reconstructed in a practical and item-centered content, which is suitable for the administrative practices and institutional systems of the Joseon Dynasty, based on precise astronomical calculation after adopting Shiheonryeok. This shows that Taekgil theory was simplified and reorganized more practically in order to suit the administrative operations of late Joseon. Third, Taekgilseo functioned as a knowledge system enabling theoretical justification and institutionalization of Taekgil. The Tegilseo and the other manuals offered grounds for determining fortune or misfortune based on various theories, and they were utilized as practical guidelines that Gwansanggam, officials, and even the general public used. Particularly, Taekgilseo was revised and published by the governments.  As it was utilized for criteria to select Taekgil for the construction of Hwaseong, traditional time-recognition systems were transformed into tools for political implements. In the construction of Hwaseong, Taekgil functioned not as a superstition to select time but as a cultural mechanism for legitimizing political authority, realizing national order, and securing ritual validity. Fourth, Taekgil of each construction phase was precisely applied by reflecting function and symbolism of them, and it implies that the architectural philosophy of King Jeongjo, which pursued simultaneously realizing functionality and symbolism, was embodied in the time consciousness. Fifth, the application of Taekgil varied depending on the type and symbolism of the buildings. In the case of gates, as they were entrances to the fortress, they were refined based on the related auspicious day. The main fortifications, as symbolic spaces of military command and surveillance, were adopted with strong elements for an auspicious day. Auxiliary fortifications showed a mix of auspicious and inauspicious elements because of functional limitations and realistic scheduling affairs. In the case of pavilions and ritual spaces, sophisticated Taekgil was applied to reflect political and ritual status. Auspicious days symbolizing Confucian virtues and harmony were repeatedly used. These are interpreted as a case that political messages through constructions were ritually conducted through Taekgil. Sixth, Sangnyangmun was not only construction records, but also ritual and ideological structures, reflecting the symbolism of architectural space and political ideology. It implicitly presented the spirit of Hwaseong construction by combining construction, Taekgil, political philosophy, and time selection. Through symbolic linkage with Hyeonnyungwon, this study emphasized that the entire Hwaseong is an implemented space of filial duty-centered Confucian political ideology, royal legitimacy, and Confucian political values of King Jeongjo, and this study verified that the construction is significant data to serve as critical materials, which prove ideological foundation and institutional coherence of national architecture in late Joseon Dynasty. &#xD;  In conclusion, the construction of Hwaseong was an integrated representative case of nation-led architecture in late Joseon Dynasty, including political ideology, Confucian principles, practical knowledge, and institutional execution ability. Across the construction process, by applying deliberate and thorough Taekgil process through specialized agencies such as Gwansanggam, philosophical elements of Harmony between Heaven and Humans, it was tried to incorporate organically Yin-Yang and the Five Elements, and Human Harmony. Not only did the Taekgil respond to natural temporal phenomena but also it involved the meaning of symbol system and semiotic order that granted human activity with order and legitimacy. Taekgil served not only as a tool for time allocation but also as a medium mechanism for realizing ideology, order, and political legitimacy.

hits.abstract: This study is about developing WMS by using UML. Although the recent industry dramatically developed, a supporting infrastructure is defective and not properly taking advantage of it. Especially, the transportation of Korea is about two times compared to Japan or USA and this point cause a problem for a business operation. Accordingly, this study suggests the development of WMS which has the function offering information to efficiently operate warehouse a solution to this problem. WMS has functions controling goods, offering information to customers and also making use of efficient space. UML was used to analysis, design and realize for the development of WMS, moreover, it will be utilized for efficient maintenance and repair, too.

hits.abstract: Park, Sung-woo & Kim, Hong-beom & Cho, Kyung-hee. 2009. Learning Management System Based on Diagnosis and Treatment for Studying Korean Language and Culture. The Language and Culture 5-3: 281-301. E-learning is defined to be a kind of education in which students and instructors interact in a cyber space via telecommunication networks. E-learning system is divided into four components: contents generation, LCMS (Learning Contents Management System), LMS (learning Management System), contents delivery. This paper proposes a model of Korean language education for e-learning system, especially focusing on LMS. Two learning paths in the LMS are provided: one for Korean language learning and the other for culture learning. Combining language learning and culture learning offers the advantage that prevents students from learning by trial and error due to cultural gaps.Each learning path in the LMS is designed on the basis of diagnosis and treatment and consists of four functional blocks: diagnosis, analysis, treatment, customized education. Learning path for Korean language education; 1) Usages and constraints of subjective postpositions are diagnosed, 2) 8 questions are presented with 44 illustrative sentences for diagnosis, 3) diagnosis results are analyzed in combination with those of culture learning, 4) error clinics and customized learning opportunities are provided for treatment and customized education. Learning path for culture education; 1) language etiquettes (greetings) are diagnosed, 2) 9 questions are presented with 40 illustrative greetings for diagnosis, 3) analysis, treatment, and customized education are performed in the same way as the language education. (Hannam University, Kongju National University)

hits.title: 지역산업 발전을 위한 블루오션전략 수립 : 래프팅산업에의 적용 사례
hits.abstract: The framework of 'blue ocean strategy (Kim and Mauborgne, 2005)' applies to not only business firm level but also region or regional industry level. The paper suggests an approach of survey-based blue ocean strategy formulation. The result from survey on customer group and non-customer group gives information on positions of value curves for regions on strategy canvas and hints on how to reposition the focal region's value curve for both increases in value for customers and decreases in cost for local government, i.e., value innovation. In the context of rafting industry in Korea, this study shows the process how blue ocean strategy can be formulated with results from the survey on customers and business people in rafting industry. Relative positions of value curves on strategy canvas and importance scores for strategy elements provides the local government in region A with implications on which elements to raise or to reduce to create 'blue ocean' in rafting industry under fierce inter-region competition.

hits.title: Pre-Service Korean Teachers' Perception of Technology
hits.abstract: Journal of the International Network for Korean Language and Culture 22-1, 263-286. This study examines the perceptions and attitudes of pre-service Korean teachers toward technology in an educational environment transformed by the COVID-19 pandemic. A survey targeting 52 pre-service teachers from a synchronous online teaching Korean practicum at Cyber University in Seoul was analyzed using the CBAM and TPACK framework. The results reveal that pre-service teachers showed notable interest in integrating technology into teaching but encountered challenges in instructional planning due to difficulties in combining TK, CK and PK. That is, even though pre-service teachers maintain a positive attitude toward technology, insufficient training and support hinder their ability to apply this interest in practice. The results emphasize the need for technology-integrated teaching models suited to varied educational contexts in the Korean Teaching Practicum and call for comprehensive professional development to equip pre-service teachers for the digital age.(Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, Hankuk University of Foreign Studies)

hits.title: Domestic Consumers’ Perceptions of Chinese e-Commerce: A Semantic Network Anlaysis Using Big Data
hits.abstract: In recent times, the phenomenon of cross-border electronic commerce in Korea has presented a range of challenges owing to the swift surge in foreign transactions among local buyers. The primary objective of this research is to elucidate insights through an examination of the attitudes of local consumers towards Aliexpress, a company that has been actively promoting its products in the Korean market and swiftly gaining a significant market share. The research methodology employed involved a comprehensive analysis of big data using text mining techniques, with the data sourced from Naver and Google archives spanning a two-year period from March 2022 to February 2024. A grand total of 102,644 data points were gathered through web scraping and subjected to analytical scrutiny. The analytical approaches utilized in this study encompassed TF-IDF analysis, centrality analysis, and CONCOR analysis, all aimed at scrutinizing the level of recognition among local consumers concerning Aliexpress, followed by a deliberation on the practical ramifications of the findings.

hits.title: Sustainable Development in the Digital Age: Harnessing Emerging Digital Technologies to Catalyze Global SDG Achievement
hits.abstract: The digital revolution, characterized by rapid technological advancements, presents a unique opportunity to accelerate progress towards the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). This research explores the transformative potential of cutting-edge digital technologies-including artificial intelligence, big data analytics, cloud computing, and the Internet of Things-in fostering sustainable development across economic, social, and environmental dimensions. Our study employs a rigorous empirical approach to quantify the impact of digital innovation on SDG achievement within the European Union. Utilizing the Digital Economy and Society Index (DESI) as a comprehensive measure of technological progress, we apply structural equation modeling to emphasize the complex interplay between digital advancement and sustainable development indicators. A key focus of our analysis is the mediating role of economic performance, measured by GDP per capita, in the relationship between digital technology adoption and SDG progress. This nuanced examination provides insights into how economic factors influence the effectiveness of digital solutions in addressing global challenges. Our findings underscore the need for adaptive policies that harness the power of digital technologies while addressing potential challenges and ensuring inclusive growth.

hits.title: 특허 빅데이터 군집분석을 통한 항공보안 미래기술 예측
hits.abstract: Aviation security technology has been emphasized than ever, since the 9.11 terror attacks in the United States. However, recent aviation terrors around the world made the urgent development of advanced aviation security technology inevitable. Information & communication technology(ICT) has recently been integrated to protect passengers from the threats by terrorist organizations and to prevent illegal activities that obstruct daily operations of airports. The development of advanced ICT-converged security technologies undergo to respond to various security concerns. In this paper, we analyze the trends in patents regarding aviation security technology from major countries and we predict the market’s emerging and non-existent technologies by using text mining techniques. In addition, we conduct a performance evaluation and acquire the validity of the prediction results through patent clustering. Furthermore, we analyze the frequency of IPC(international patent classification) codes and identify their relationships to Korean patents by using association rule mining techniques.

hits.title: 녹색성장 전략에서 IT의 역할과 정책 과제 - 그린 IT 인프라 및 서비스 우선순위 도출을 중심으로
hits.abstract:
녹생성장이 미래 국가 발전 전략으로 떠오르기 시작하면서 녹색성장 실현을 위한 핵심 수단으로서 IT의 중요성이 강조되고 있다. 이에 본 연구는 우리나라의 녹색성장 전략을 실현하기 위해 미래 IT 인프라 및 서비스는 어떠한 방향으로 발전하고 어떤 역할을 해야 할 것인지를 구체화하고 이를 위한 정책 과제는 무엇인지를 중점적으로 규명하고자 하였다. 이를 위해 본 연구는 전문가 인터뷰 및 설문을 통해 핵심 IT 인프라 및 서비스를 도출하고, AHP 기법을 적용하여 이들간의 상대적 우선순위를 분석하였다.

 전문가 조사 결과, 녹색성장 전략을 지원하는 그린 IT 인프라에는 ① 클라우드 컴퓨팅, ② 사물 인터넷, ③ 전력선 광대역, ④ 스마트 그리드, ⑤ IP-TV가 제시되었고, 녹색성장 실현을 위한 핵심 그린 IT 서비스로는 ① 건물에너지 관리시스템, ② 지능형 교통시스템, ③ 실시간 환경/재난 모니터링 시스템, ④ 스마트워크, ⑤ 소셜 네트워크가 도출되었다. 도출된 그린 IT 인프라 및 서비스에 대한 상대적 우선순위를 분석한 결과, 인프라 분야에서는 전력선 광대역과 사물 인터넷의 중요도가 상대적으로 높게 나타났고, 서비스 분야에서는 실시간 재난/환경 모니터링 시스템과 지능형 교통시스템, 건물에너지관리시스템 등이 우선순위가 높은 서비스로 지목되었다. 조사에 참여한 전문가들은 제시된 기술의 개발과 서비스의 실현을 위해 정부는 일관된 R&D 정책을 추진해야 하며, 기초기술과 인적자원에 대한 투자를 계속해야 함을 강조하였다. 아울러 융합관련 R&D 확충 및 낙후지역 통신망 인프라 구축에도 힘써야 한다는 의견을 제시하였다.

hits.title: 보건/의료산업 융합에 따른 의료정보화 시스템 연구
hits.abstract: 우리 사회의 급속한 변화 현상중의 하나를 선택한다면 아마도 급속한 고령화 인구의 증가라 할 수 있을 것이다. 고령화 인구의 증가는 다양한 사회적 문제들을 야기시키고 있다. 이와 관련하여 점점 중요성이 높아지면서, 해결해야 되는 문제가 의료정보 시스템일 것이다. 의료융합 산업이 관광산업의 한 축이 될 수 있는 환경에서는 의료정보 시스템의 중요성은 아무리 강조해도 지나침이 없다. 가까운 태국은 의료산업을 기반으로 한 관광산업의 대표적인 나라라 할 수 있다. 이러한 추세를 반영하여 관련 연구들이 활발히 이루어지고 있으며, 관련 응용 상품들도 개발되고 있다. 이에 본 논문에서는 IT와 의료산업의 융복합 형태인 통합 의료정보 시스템에 대한 현황 및 문제점, 향후 발전 방향등에 대해 고찰하였다.

hits.title: 한국 모바일 산업의 플랫폼 사례 연구
hits.abstract: 모바일 생태계는 콘텐츠-플랫폼-네트워크-디바이스(C-P-N-D)로 구성된다. 애플은 자체 운영체제(OS)인 iOS를 기반으로 콘텐츠와 디바이스를 아우르는 독자 생태계(Eco System)를 성공적으로 구축했다. 반면 10년 전까지 전세계 휴대전화 시장을 장악했던 핀란드의 노키아는 시장에서 완전히 밀려났다. 선행연구에 따르면 애플이 시장을 장악할 수 있던 가장 큰 요인은 음악, 동영상, 애플리케이션 등 콘텐츠 시장을 선도했기 때문이다. 독자적인 콘텐츠 시장을 구축할 생각을 하지 못했던 기존 디바이스 제조업체들은 구글의 안드로이드 플랫폼과의 협력을 통해 새로운 성장 기회를 마련했다. 하지만 안드로이드 진영에서도 업체별로 차별화가 진행되고 있다. 주요 정보기술(IT) 업체들에 사례 연구를 통해 같은 생태계를 활용하는데도 경쟁력의 격차가 벌어지는 이유를 살펴보고, 모바일 플랫폼이 콘텐츠·소프트웨어 분야에서의 경쟁력 뿐 아니라 디바이스·하드웨어 분야에서의 경쟁력까지 좌우하는 핵심요인이라는 점을 다시 한 번 확인했다. 부품과 최종 디바이스 부분에서도 플랫폼 자체의 변화와 진보를 이끌어낼 독자적인 설계, 개발 능력을 갖춘 업체만이 수익성과 시장 점유율을 확보할 수 있는 것이다. 한국 업체들은 자체 플랫폼을 확장·강화하는 미국 애플과 가격경쟁력을 갖춘 디바이스로 추격의 속도를 높이는 중국 샤오미 사이에서 새로운 도전에 직면하고 있다. 노키아의 예에서 볼 수 있듯이 자체 플랫폼 구축은 성공하기 어렵다. 기존 생태계와 호환성을 유지하면서 성능과 확장성 면에서 차별화할 수 있는 플랫폼 융합 디바이스를 선도하는 전략이 필요하다. 정부는 규제완화를 통해 기업들이 다양한 시도를 할 수 있는 환경을 갖춰야 하고, 개별 기업은 이를 바탕으로 틈새시장 개척과 게임 체인저가 될 수 있는 새로운 분야를 발굴하는 노력이 필요한 시점이다.

hits.title: SW를 통한 북한경제 활성화 연구
hits.abstract: 남한과 북한의 경제격차가 갈수록 커지고 있다. 60년 대만해도 남한보다 잘 살았던 북한은 지금은 세계 최빈국중 하나로 전락했다. 반면 남한은 지난 수 십 년간 꾸준히 경제성장에 성공, 세계 10위 권대 경제를 이루어냈다. 선진국클럽이라 불리는 OECD에도 1996년 12월 가입했다. 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)을 놓고 비교하면 남한과 북한은 약 18배가 차이난다. 이런 차이는 시간이 갈수록 커질 것이다. 이 같은 남북 격차 속에서 통일이 이루어진다면 어떻게 될까. 남북 모두가 불행해질 것은 명약관화하다. 통일은 언젠가 이루어 질 것이다. 단지, 그 시기가 문제다. 당장 내년에 이루어질 수 있고 10년, 20년이 걸릴 수도 있다. 하지만 대부분의 국내외 한반도 전문가들은 남북통일이 반세기 안에 이루어질 것으로 전망하고 있다. 이런 상황에서 우리는 통일 후 혼란을 조금이라도 줄이기 위해서 남북한 경제격차를 하루빨리 조금이라도 좁혀야 한다. 즉, 북한 경제가 하루빨리 활성화하고 수준이 높아져야 통일 후유증을 조금이라도 줄일 수 있는 것이다. 어떻게 하면 북한경제를 발전시키고 활성화시킬 수 있을까. 북한은 경제발전에 필요한 자원은 어느 정도 가지고 있다. 예컨대 텅스텐 저장량은 세계 제일이다. 다른 광물도 많이 가지고 있다. 하지만 이들을 개발하기 위한 도로, 전기 같은 사회 인프라가 전혀 안 갖춰져 있어 이들을 개발하려고 해도 개발 할 수가 없다. 결국, 교통, 도로 같은 사회 인프라가 없이도 발전할 수 있는 컴퓨터 소프트웨어에서 그 답을 찾아야 한다. 북한도 이를 잘 알고 있다. 그래서 이미 1980년대부터 소프트웨어 산업과 인력 양성에 힘을 기울여 왔다. 그 결과, 사무용 소프트웨어를 개발했으며 최근에는 소프트웨어 중 소프트웨어라 불리는 운용체계(OS)까지 개발해 남한사회에 비상한 관심을 불러일으켰다. 북한이 이처럼 소프트웨어에 강한 면모를 보이는 것은 소프트웨어가 순전히 우수한 인력만 있으면 되는 ‘사람 장사’이기 때문이다. 북한은 오는 2012년까지 ‘강성대국’(북한판 강국)을 이룩하려 하고 있다. 이의 근간으로 북한은 소프트웨어와 IT를 내세우고 있다. 특히 지난 2000년 김정일 국방위원장이 중국을 방문한 것을 계기로 북한의 소프트웨어 육성은 더욱 속도를 내고 있다. 컴퓨터 수재반이 신설되는 등 북한 당국이 소프트웨어에 큰 관심을 기울이면서 소프트웨어는 북한 내 가장 유망한 분야로 떠올랐다. 북한 소프트웨어 인력을 활용해 아웃소싱 사업을 하고 있는 남한 기업들은 북한에 약 2만 5천 명 정도의 소프트웨어 인력이 있는 것으로 추정하고 있다. 하지만 안타깝게도 북한에는 이들을 수용할 기업과 산업이 태부족하다. 이런 까닭에 일부 남한 기업가들은 북한 개발자를 활용한 SW 아웃소싱 사업을 지난 2001년부터 전개하고 있다. 남북 사업은 그 특성상 남북관계에 즉각 영향을 받는다. 이 때문에 남북 정부 간 관계가 좋았던 김대중 정부와 노무현 정부 때는 남북 비즈니스도 꽤 활성화 됐다. 그러나 이명박 정부 들어 남북관계가 급랭하면서 남북 비즈니스도 크게 위축됐다. 그래서 불과 2년 전만 해도 북한 개발자를 활용해 비즈니스 하는 남한 기업이 10여 곳 됐지만 2010년 6월 현재 4개 밖에 남아 있지 않다. 북한의 소프트웨어 파워는 마치 인도를 연상시킨다. 인도 정부의 전폭적인 지원에 힘입어 세계적 소프트웨어 강국으로 부상했으며 소프트웨어 전공자가 우대받고 있다. 인도가 소프트웨어 강국으로 도약한 데는 정부와 기관, 기업 등 민관연이 하나가 되어 뭉쳤기 때문이다. 여기에 영어와 수학이 강한 사회문화적 영향이 힘을 보탰고 세계최대 시장인 미국이 든든히 받쳐주었다. 소프트웨어 인력과 수준이 어느 정도 오른 북한도 인도 못지않은 소프트웨어 강국이 될 잠재력이 높다. 실제로 북한 개발자를 이용해 소프트웨어 아웃소싱 사업을 하고 있는 남한 기업가들은 이구동성으로 북한의 소프트웨어 실력이 우수하다고 말한다. 하지만 북한이 인도와 같은 소프트웨어 강국이 되고, 또 북한 경제발전의 원동력이 되기 위해서는 해결해야 할 과제도 적지 않다. 무엇보다 소프트웨어를 제대로 가르칠 교육 시설과 하드웨어 장비, 교재 등을 하루빨리 갖춰야 하며 개혁과 개방의 길로 나와야 한다.

hits.abstract: As the Internet of Things, artificial intelligence and big data have received a lot of attention as key growth engines in the era of the fourth industrial revolution, data acquisition and utilization in mobile, automotive, robotics, manufacturing, agriculture, health care and national defense are becoming more important. Due to numerous data-based industrial changes, demand for sensor technologies is exploding, especially for intelligent sensor technologies that combine control, judgement, storage and communication functions with the sensors's own functions. Intelligent sensor technology can be defined as a convergence component technology that combines intelligent sensor units, intelligent algorithms, modules with signal processing circuits, and integrated plaform technologies. Intelligent sensor technology, which can be applied to variety of smart IT convergence services such as smart devices, smart homes, smart cars, smart factory, smart cities, and others, is evolving towards intelligent and convergence technologies that produce new high-value information through recognition, reasoning, and judgement based on artificial intelligence. As a result, development of intelligent sensor units is accelerating with strategies for miniaturization, low-power consumption and convergence, new form factor such as flexible and stretchable form, and integration of high-resolution sensor arrays. In the future, these intelligent sensor technologies will lead explosive sensor industries in the era of data-based artificial intelligence and will greatly contribute to enhancing nation's competitiveness in the global sensor market. In this report, we analyze and summarize the recent trends in intelligent sensor technologies, especially those for four core technologies.
